texts.facts: In this case, a Detailed Accident Report (hereinafter referred as DAR) was filed by IO Onkar Singh in terms of provisions of Motor Vehicle Act, which is treated as Claim Petition under Section 166 (1) read with Section 166 (4) MV Act. It pertains to alleged accident of injured Shashi Ranjan (hereinafter referred as claimant), by vehicle bearing Reg. No. UP 16K 9817 (hereinafter referred as offending vehicle), which was driven & possessed by Shujauddin (hereinafter referred as R- 1), and owned by Amar Singh (hereinafter referred as R-2). 2. Preliminary information about the accident was received on 08.06.2019 recorded vide DD no.17A at PS Kalindi Kunj, in response to which, HC Nahar Singh along with Ct. Pooran proceeded to Shri Ram Chowk, Madanpur Khadar (hereinafter referred as spot of accident) where they found an auto bearing Reg. No. UP16K-9817 lying in a ditch in accidental condition and it was informed that injured had already been taken to hospital. HC Nahar Singh rushed to AIIMS Trauma Center where he found 4 injured persons namely Sijauddin, vide MLC no.500174514/19, Siraj, Shashi Ranjan and Rajiv Ranjan admitted for treatment. Doctor had mentioned Rajiv Ranjan to be medically fit for statement, while Shash Ranjan and Siraj were declared unfit for statement. Statement of Rajiv Ranjan was recorded wherein he stated that he was traveling in an auto from MACT No.: 563/2019 Shashi Ranjan Jha Vs. Shujauddin & Ors. Page No. 2 of 31 Khadda colony to Noida on 08.06.2019 at about 08.15 am, while two other passengers were also sitting with him in the said auto. He stated that auto was being plied at very high speed which was objected by the passengers but the auto driver did not pay any heed and eventually, when it was taking a turn towards Yamuna Pusta that it toppled and fell down in a ditch because of the which driver as well as all the passengers sustained serious injuries. He stated that injured persons were rushed to Hospital in Ambulance and PCR van. He identified auto driver as Shujauddin S/o Jiauddin and accused him of driving the auto speedily and in rash and negligent manner because of which it met with an accident. FIR was registered. Investigation was assigned to ASI Omkar Singh who reached at the spot of accident and met HC Nahar Singh at spot who pointed at TSR still lying toppled. Said TSR was taken into police possession. Site plan was prepared. Statement u/s 161 Cr.PC was recorded. Sijauddin was found driving the auto without any relevant document. He could neither produce any license nor could he produce insurance, permit or fitness. RC of the offending vehicle was found to be valid, however, owner could not be traced out on the RC particulars. Upon conclusion of investigation, Charge-sheet u/s 279/338 IPC, 3/181, 146/196, 56/192, 66(1)192A MV Act was filed before Ld.
